title: The Banker
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dunder Mifflin prepares for a visit from an investment banker who is conducting due diligence ahead of a potential sale. Michael Scott makes cosmetic and technological upgrades to impress the banker, while Eric Ward inspects the warehouse and questions HR about liabilities. Toby struggles with how to respond to inquiries about company issues. Despite the tension, Michael remains optimistic about the company's future. The episode also features a humorous musical performance by Michael and Dwight celebrating their town with the 'Lazy Scranton' video.

main_threads.thread: The investment banker Eric Ward visits Dunder Mifflin to conduct due diligence, inspecting the warehouse and questioning HR about liabilities and company issues.

evidence.snippet: Eric: Uh, I just need to check out your warehouse and then talk to your HR guy.
Eric: It's called 'due diligence'. Basically, I confirm inventory, take a head count, see if there are any HR liabilities.
Toby: I don't know how I'm going to get through this. I don't want to lie and I DON'T want to tell the truth.

Eric: What about non-safety issues, in terms of liability? Sexual harassment. Anything like that?
Toby: Oh, I don't know.
